entities.name: Akagi River
entities.description: River of Kamigawa flowing from Lake Kamitaki past Sugi Hayashi into the Jukai Forest.

entities.name: Lake Kamitaki
entities.description: Source lake of the Akagi River.

entities.name: Battle of Akagi River
entities.description: One of the Great Battles of Kamigawa, fought at the river.

entities.name: Munetsugu Takeno
entities.description: General who fought cedar and magma kami at the Akagi River.

events.summary: General Munetsugu Takeno and his battalion fight several fierce cedar and magma kami at the Battle of Akagi River.
events.quote: general Munetsugu Takeno and a battalion of his troops fought several fierce cedar and magma kami
